name: Jarvis
changes_cs: Pridava okno Obnova prace v menu Nastroje: prerusene ulohy jdou zkontrolovat, znovu zaradit, oznacit jako opustene nebo exportovat bez spamovani chatu.
changes_en: Adds a Work recovery window under Tools: interrupted jobs can be reviewed, safely requeued, marked abandoned, or exported without spamming the chat.

history.changes_cs: Pridava okno Obnova prace v menu Nastroje: prerusene ulohy jdou zkontrolovat, znovu zaradit, oznacit jako opustene nebo exportovat bez spamovani chatu.
history.changes_en: Adds a Work recovery window under Tools: interrupted jobs can be reviewed, safely requeued, marked abandoned, or exported without spamming the chat.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridava dialog Sdilene pracovni povedomi: v Nastroje lze zobrazit relevantni zdrojove chaty ze stejneho projektu, precist si duvod relevance a otevrit zdrojovy chat bez spamovani konverzace.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds a Shared work awareness dialog: Tools can show relevant source chats from the same project, explain why they matter, and open the source chat without spamming the conversation.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu publikovan na vyzadani s aktualnim CPM/WDUi stavem a cerstvym setup/update manifestem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was republished on request with the current CPM/WDUi state and a fresh setup/update manifest.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan na vyzadani s aktualnim CPM/WDUi stavem, setupem a ADPU update manifestem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published on request with the current CPM/WDUi state, setup package, and ADPU update manifest.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis lepe predava SharedWork zdroje modelu: prompt obsahuje duvody shody a pravidlo, ze jde jen o read-only kontext z jinych chatu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now passes SharedWork sources to the model with relevance reasons and an explicit read-only other-chat rule.

history.changes_cs: Diagnostika Jarvise ukazuje SharedWork zdroje, ze kterych worker pri odpovedi cerpal.
history.changes_en: Jarvis diagnostics now show SharedWork sources used by the worker while answering.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan na vyzadani s aktualnim stavem CPM a WDUi artefaktu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published on request with the current CPM and WDUi artifact state.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan s aktualnim buildem, setupem, checksumem a pripravou sdileneho pracovního povedomi mezi chaty.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published with the current build, setup, checksum, and shared work awareness preparation between chats.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis uklada worker checkpointy do Sdileneho pracovniho povedomi a dalsim chatum ve stejnem projektu pridava kratky read-only kontext z jinych chatu bez prava je ukolovat.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now publishes worker checkpoints into Shared Work Awareness and adds concise same-project read-only context from other chats without allowing chats to assign work to each other.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl publikovan s aktualni WDUi build-info integraci a roadmapou Sdileneho pracovniho povedomi bez regrese verejne verze. Build cesta Jarvise kompiluje WDUi vcetne DesignUiBuildInfo.cpp a release setup navazuje na predchozi 0.1.479 opravy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was published with the current WDUi build-info integration and Shared Work Awareness roadmap without regressing the public version. The Jarvis build path compiles WDUi including DesignUiBuildInfo.cpp and the release setup builds on the previous 0.1.479 fixes.

history.changes_cs: Diagnostika Jarvise nově exportuje souhrn agentické stopy: poslední úkol, routing, použitý model, policy/executor průběh a poslední problém bez zahlcení běžného chatu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis diagnostics now export an agent trace summary: latest job, routing, selected model, policy/executor flow, and last problem without cluttering normal chat.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis napojuje workspace souborove akce na PolicyExecutor: /read, /explain, /review-file a potvrzene /apply-patch ted zapisuji executor.policy trace. /apply-patch bez --confirm se odmita pres file-write boundary, ne jen textovou hlaskou.
history.changes_en: Jarvis connects workspace file actions to PolicyExecutor: /read, /explain, /review-file, and confirmed /apply-patch now write executor.policy traces. /apply-patch without --confirm is rejected through the file-write boundary, not just a text shortcut.

history.changes_cs: PolicyExecutor rozlisuje workspace file read/list a potvrzovane file mutation akce; souborove kroky uz nejsou maskovane jako shell/process.
history.changes_en: PolicyExecutor now distinguishes workspace file read/list from confirmed file mutation actions; file steps are no longer treated as shell/process launches.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridal guard pro bezny chat: pred zobrazenim odpovedi overi, ze model neodpovida na stary ukol, ukazkovy normalize_status kod, interni router log nebo spatne tvrzeni o PowerShellu. Pokud odpoved ujede od posledniho dotazu, Jarvis ji zkusi prepsat z aktualni zpravy a spatnou verzi nezobrazi.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds an ordinary chat response guard: before showing an answer it checks that the model did not drift into an old task, sample normalize_status code, internal router logs, or an incorrect PowerShell capability claim. If the answer drifts from the latest user request, Jarvis rewrites it from the current message and does not show the bad draft.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis rozsiril sdileny PolicyExecutor z lokalniho shellu i na workspace build/test presety a Git. Build, test, git status/diff/log, commit a push ted pred procesem zapisuji executor.policy trace a pouzivaji stejnou preflight hranici pro potvrzeni, workspace, dostupny nastroj a opravneni.
history.changes_en: Jarvis extends the shared PolicyExecutor from local shell commands to workspace build/test presets and Git. Build, test, git status/diff/log, commit, and push now write an executor.policy trace before process launch and use the same preflight boundary for confirmation, workspace, available tool, and permissions.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridava prvni UI-neutralni policy gate pro lokalni executor: PowerShell, Command Prompt, Git Bash a WSL se pred spustenim jednotne kontroluji na potvrzeni, Plny pristup, platny workspace, dostupny nastroj a auditovatelnou launch hranici.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds the first UI-neutral policy gate for the local executor: PowerShell, Command Prompt, Git Bash, and WSL now share pre-launch checks for confirmation, Full access, valid workspace, available tool, and an auditable launch boundary.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis zpevnuje dogfood/eval smycku: self-test ted hlida katalog 20 konverzacnich scenaru a povinne kategorie proti driftu od aktualni zpravy, projektu, souboru, jazyka, shell schopnosti a failure surface.
history.changes_en: Jarvis hardens the dogfood/eval loop: the self-test now enforces a catalog of 20 conversation scenarios and required coverage categories against drift from the current message, project, files, language, shell capability, and failure surface.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridava privacy-first diagnostiku: lokalni technicke udalosti, sanitizovany export diagnostickeho balicku na vyzadani a opt-in stav anonymni telemetrie bez automatickeho odesilani obsahu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds privacy-first diagnostics: local technical events, a sanitized on-demand diagnostic export package, and opt-in anonymous telemetry state without automatically uploading content.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis si u netrivialnich agentickych dotazu pripravi kratky plan navazany na aktualni zadani, podklady, opravneni a overeni, aby lepe drzel smer prace.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now prepares a short plan for non-trivial agent requests, tied to the current request, evidence, permissions, and verification, so it keeps the work on track.

history.changes_cs: Rebuild Jarvise s aktualnim WDUi a publish balickem.
history.changes_en: Rebuild Jarvis with the current WDUi and publish package.

history.changes_cs: Pridava zivy dogfood dotaz na schopnosti PowerShellu: Jarvis uz nema tvrdit, ze PowerShell neumi, a ma vysvetlit Plny pristup, potvrzovani konkretnich spusteni a prakticke pouziti bez internich slash prikazu.
history.changes_en: Adds a live dogfood probe for PowerShell capability: Jarvis should no longer claim it cannot use PowerShell, and should explain Full access, per-run confirmation, and practical use without exposing internal slash commands.

history.changes_cs: Zpevňuje živý dogfood projektového startu: Jarvis umí opravit odpověď, která ujede od zadání, normalizuje klikatelné návrhy JarvisAction a lépe rozlišuje ukázkový úkol ve zdrojích od skutečného uživatelského požadavku.
history.changes_en: Hardens live project-intake dogfood: Jarvis can repair drifted project answers, normalizes clickable JarvisAction suggestions, and better separates sample source tasks from the user's actual request.

history.changes_cs: Pridan live dogfood test projektoveho nacteni a prisnejsi kontrola, aby odpoved neujizdela do nesouvisejicich kodovych ukolu.
history.changes_en: Added a live project-intake dogfood test and stricter checks so replies do not drift into unrelated coding tasks.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma novou headless dogfood branu --self-test-dogfood pro projektovy start. Test hlida, ze prompt a drift guardy odmitnou odpovedi, ktere misto zhodnoceni projektu resi nahodny ukol z ukazkoveho kodu, ptaji se uzivatele na veci uz dostupne v podkladech, sklouznou do obecneho checklistu nebo pouziji anglicke sekcni nadpisy v ceskem rezimu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now includes a headless --self-test-dogfood gate for project intake. The test verifies that prompts and drift guards reject answers that solve a sample code task instead of assessing the project, ask the user for information already present in sources, fall back to a generic checklist, or use English section headings in Czech mode.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri modelovem uvazovani zobrazuje animovane 'Premyslim' v prvni osobe a thinking udalosti se zapisuji jako lidske pracovni komentare, ktere se po dokonceni schovaji do souhrnu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now shows first-person animated thinking text while the model reasons, and thinking events become human work comments that collapse into the work summary after completion.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis project-intake prompt v ceskem rezimu uz neukazuje modelu anglicke nazvy sekci a guard zachyti i smisenou odpoved s ceskym textem, ale anglickymi nadpisy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis project-intake prompts no longer show English section names in Czech mode, and the guard now catches mixed answers with Czech text but English headings.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven s aktualni WDUi knihovnou a znovu publikovan do ADPU.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt with the current WDUi library and republished to ADPU.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis project-intake guard zachyti anglicky sekcni vystup, kdyz je vychozi jazyk odpovedi cestina, a posle ho do repair/fallback toku misto zobrazeni uzivateli.
history.changes_en: Jarvis project-intake guard now catches English sectioned output when the default response language is Czech, routing it through repair/fallback instead of showing it to the user.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis project-intake odpovedi musi byt ukotvene ve skutecnych podkladech projektu: formalne spravne, ale obecne checklisty bez rozpoznatelne evidence se ted opravi nebo nahradi bezpecnym fallbackem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis project-intake answers must now be grounded in actual project evidence: formally correct but generic checklists without recognizable source anchors are repaired or replaced with a safe fallback.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven po aktualnim reasoning UX rezu a download metadata byla srovnana s lokalnim setup buildem 0.1.460.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt after the current reasoning UX slice and download metadata was aligned with the local 0.1.460 setup build.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri volani modelu pouziva explicitni stav Premyslim s animovanym WDUi ShimmerText a po dokonceni modeloveho streamu ho spolehlive vypina, aby chat nepusobil jako tichy nebo technicky log.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now uses an explicit Reasoning state with animated WDUi ShimmerText during model calls and reliably clears it after the model stream completes, so chat does not feel silent or like a technical log.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis zprisnuje project-intake guard: klikaci start projektu musi dodat tri kroky a JarvisAction navrhy, jinak odpoved opravi nebo nahradi bezpecnym fallbackem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tightens the project-intake guard: one-click project start must provide three steps and JarvisAction suggestions, otherwise the answer is repaired or replaced with a safe fallback.

history.changes_cs: Rebuild Jarvise s aktualni WDUi knihovnou a znovu publikovanym setup/update balikem.
history.changes_en: Rebuild Jarvis with the current WDUi library and republish the setup/update package.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis zpresnuje project-intake guard podle realne spatne konverzace: blokuje kodovy vystup, reseni ukazkoveho TODO a ptani se uzivatele na projekt, kdyz uz ma podklady.
history.changes_en: Jarvis tightens the project-intake guard based on a real bad transcript: it blocks code output, sample TODO solving, and asking the user to explain the project when evidence is already available.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis chrani projektovy start pred odbocenim do ukazkovych ukolu ze zdrojaku a kontroluje project-intake odpoved pred zobrazenim.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now guards project intake against drifting into sample tasks from project files and validates the answer before showing it.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven a publikovan s aktualnimi CPM a WDUi zmenami.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt and published with current CPM and WDUi changes.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven s aktualnim obsahem bundled skills a aktualni WDUi knihovnou.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt with the current bundled skills content and the latest WDUi library.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri uvazovani modelu zobrazuje animovane 'Premysli' primo v chatu a WDUi ma novy skinovatelny ShimmerText control.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now shows an animated thinking indicator while the model is reasoning, backed by a reusable skinnable WDUi ShimmerText control.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma oddeleny WorkerQueue modul pro frontu prace, presuny, prioritu a snapshoty. Smoke test nově overuje frontu samostatnym self-testem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has a separate WorkerQueue module for the work queue, reordering, priority, and snapshots. Smoke tests now cover the queue with a dedicated self-test.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pokracuje v Modularization Tracku: detekce aktivniho a sledovaneho stahovani modelu se presunula z Jarvis.cpp do JarvisModelDownloadService.h/.cpp. App shell si nechava jen kompatibilni wrappery, zatimco service vlastni snapshot aktivniho pozadavku, active-vs-queue tracking a self-testy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis continues the Modularization Track: active and tracked model-download detection moved from Jarvis.cpp into JarvisModelDownloadService.h/.cpp. The app shell keeps only compatibility wrappers while the service owns active request snapshots, active-vs-queue tracking, and self-test coverage.
